title: CHASAM 2026: NEP and Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials
body_html: Attended CHASAM 2026, the Chalmers School on Atomic-scale Modeling in Gothenburg (28 September - 2 October), with hands-on training in neuroevolution potentials (NEP) and machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs).

title: All-Perovskite Heterojunctions Published in Nano Letters
body_html: Our collaborative study on all-perovskite low-dimensional/quantum-dot heterojunctions is now published in Nano Letters. The work examines interface engineering to improve charge extraction and moisture stability in perovskite quantum-dot solar cells.

title: Lead-Bromide Perovskite DFTB Parameters Published in JCP
body_html: Our paper on DFTB parameters for lead-bromide perovskites, perovskitoids, and related structures is now published in The Journal of Chemical Physics. The study extends efficient electronic-structure modelling to bromide and mixed-halide systems.

title: MCC Summer Conference 2026 at Daresbury Laboratory
body_html: Presented my research at the Materials Chemistry Consortium (MCC) Summer Conference at STFC Daresbury Laboratory, held on 1-3 July 2026.

title: Research Associate at the University of York
body_html: Joined the School of Physics, Engineering and Technology at the University of York as a Research Associate.

title: Quasi-2D Perovskite Photostability in ACS Energy Letters
body_html: Co-first-author paper on device-operando photostability of quasi-2D Ruddlesden-Popper perovskites published in ACS Energy Letters.

title: Iodide Perovskite DFTB Parameters in Physical Review Materials
body_html: Published DFTB parameters for electronic-structure prediction of iodide perovskites and heterostructures in Physical Review Materials.

title: Conference Presentations: MATSUS, E-MRS, and French Meetings
body_html: Presented work at MATSUS, E-MRS, and French national meetings on metal-halide perovskites and nanomaterials for energy.
